chapter: Beale Street and the early Memphis scene
title: Benny Frenchy and the Monarch on Beale Street
summary: Allen asks about pianist Benny Frenchy, who played with Handy's band and at the Monarch, a gambling house.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Benny Frenchy used to play with Handys.
That's the one I'm talking about.
Did he play around the Monarch? He played with the Monarch. Yeah, that's what I'm thinking about. That's right.
He played the Monarch on Beale Street.
What kind of place was that?
That was a crap house. He'd shoot dice, gambling, everything there. Cut, throw, thieves, everything.
